_widening_note: v2 widens all seven weight_* knobs from low=0,high=3 to low=0,high=6 (step=1). Supported by the bound environment: tools/experiment_loop/ios_env/corpus.py:27 declares the current domain (Knob(name=f"weight_{s}", kind=KNOB_INT, default=1, low=0, high=3, step=1)), and the underlying weight consumer accepts any non-negative integer - ios_research/src/ios_research/mutation.py:182 encodes weights as pool repetition (built.extend([strat] * max(0, int(weights.get(strat, 1))))) via common.py:38 weights_from_config. Activation requires the matching one-line knob_list edit in corpus.py:27 (high=3 -> high=6); this goal file alone does not move the generator, which samples against env knob declarations. Id bumped v1->v2 because Goal.stable_id ignores knob ranges and declared ids override it anyway, so resuming under -v1 would reuse a knowledge base saturated by lessons learned on the 0..3 domain.
